outcome: Relative abundance of Lactobacillus and Clostridium cluster III
Carriage rates of uropathogenic E. coli
cohort: 146 preterm neonates (PNs) with or without NEC
finding: At disease onset, the gut microbiota of preterm neonates with NEC showed a lower abundance of Lactobacillus and a higher abundance of Clostridium cluster III compared to controls, suggesting gut microbiota dysbiosis in NEC.
mod_finding: This study on gut microbiota in preterm neonates with and without necrotizing enterocolitis found a statistical association between gut microbiota composition and cesarean delivery, among other factors.
